title: NIST Dictionary of Algorithms and Data Structures: unsolvableProblem
text:
unsolvable problem
unsolvable problem
(definition)
Definition:
A computational problem that cannot be solved by a
Turing machine
.  The associated function is called an
uncomputable function
.
See also
solvable
,
undecidable problem
,
intractable
,
halting problem
.
Note:
